0.original: Zukin has an eye for eggs.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

24.original: Lure out tatsunoko with live ruby shrimp near Sakazuki and slay them for their roe.

25.original: Deliver the tatsunoko roe to the cook at the Ruby Price.

26.original: Deliver the fine Hingan wine to Zukin.

48.original: Ah, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, the very <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03> I was seeking. There is a task I would have you perform in the name of trade relations.

49.original: Take these live ruby shrimp and release them along the shore of Sakazuki. This will lure out tatsunoko, whose roe you may then harvest.

50.original: Once you have the roe, pray deliver it to the cook at the Ruby Price. He will know what to do with it. My thanks in advance, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

51.original: Looking for the cook? You've found him. What is it you require?

52.original: Oho, if this isn't tatsunoko roe, and some of the freshest I've seen! Compliments of Zukin, you say? Well, how thoughtful of him!

53.original: In case you didn't know, tatsunoko roe is a rare delicacy. I'll be able to prepare such a treat for our troops as they seldom enjoy! Now, such kindness shouldn't go unacknowledged...

54.original: One of the finest wines I have in my stores. Please give it to Zukin along with my regards. And with that, I take my leave─I have a feast to prepare!

55.original: ...Our gift was so well received that we received one in return? Wonderful!

56.original: <sniff> Ah, this is truly a fine rice wine. We've not the means to brew our own, so it is doubly appreciated. My thanks for handling the task, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

57.original: Ever since we began trading with Kokajiya, travel to Kugane has become a regularity. This in turn led to more opportunities for contact with the Ruby Price.

58.original: For now, the fortification serves simply as a convenient waypoint, but ere long it will become a destination in its own right. Our efforts to establish new trade channels continue to flourish, and we owe no small part of our success to you.
